description: Adds, changes or takes out one of the owner's own facts (Brand › Business › What Marsell knows, as Add a fact does there): what is true about the business, which every plan, post, page and claim check reads from then on, ahead of the facts setup confirmed. A confirmed fact that is wrong or out of date stays as it was set and is corrected by the true one here, said as a correction ("Launch: the Product Hunt launch is no longer on 27 October 2026; it comes later, and no date is set yet."); a rule is for what Marsell must or must not do, never for a fact. text alone adds a fact; id with text changes it; id with remove takes it out. Only what the owner said or a source shows, never a guess. Free. It needs an act key.

id.description: the owner's fact to change or take out, by its id from owner_facts_read

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

remove.description: true takes the fact named by id out

text.description: the fact, whole, in the owner's words or as a source shows it, with what it is about first: "Launch: the Product Hunt launch is no longer on 27 October 2026; it comes later, and no date is set yet." A new fact, or the new words of the one named by id.

name: owner_fact_set
title: Owner fact set
